Dexterity is one of the five main Character Attributes. Dexterity is related to the character's ability to avoid hits from and an enemy and to quickly strike an enemy.

## Effect of Dexterity[]

Each point of Dexterity that a character has grants

- An additional 4 points to the maximum Dodge Rating

## Equipment[]

Currently, there is no equipment that grants additional Dexterity.
